shortDescription: Manage ILM policy tags on StorageGRID.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the StorageGRID Admin Node REST API.

options.name: auth_token
options.description: The authorization token for the API request

options.name: description
options.description: The description of this policy tag. Visible to tenants, do not include sensitive information.

options.name: name
options.description: The unique name of this tag. Assigning an ILM policy to this tag applies the policy only to buckets tagged with NTAP-SG-ILM-BUCKET as the key and this name as the value (case-insensitive). Visible to tenants, do not include sensitive information.

options.name: policy_id
options.description: The ID of the ILM policy that will use this tag.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified ILM policy tag should be created or deleted.
